# Lore QA dev pilot (generated by analysis/lore_pilot.py)

Control host, HF backend, greedy, dev split only (src/exp/lore_pilot.py). Every output is rescored with lore scorer 1.1.0; "as run" is the verdict written at run time (scorer 1.0.1). HF and vLLM greedy outputs differ, so the gates are re-measured with vLLM on the run host before any test run (proposal §7). Accuracy in % with a Wilson 95 % interval.

## Gates (4B)

- Lore test items: 692.
- **G2**: chosen budget 1024; 512: 90.1 %, 1024: 87.7 %, 2048: 88.3 % (as run: 75.4 %, 74.9 %, 74.3 %) → fail (above the upper bound at every budget): D-nat-lore descriptive, D-inj-lore primary.
- **G3**: 0.0 % unparsed + truncated + conflict → pass.
- **G4**: 85 projected initially wrong test items → fail: D-nat-lore descriptive.
- **G3b**: 9 of 89 held-out phrase pairs scored against the blind judge → fail: phrase items descriptive.
